rationale: The agent properly verified identity using full name and ZIP, matched to a single user before sharing order details. It located the correct tablet order and provided the tracking number from tool data. For all order-changing actions (tablet return, charger cancellation, boots and kettle cancellation, sneakers return), the agent clearly stated the intended action and obtained explicit user confirmation prior to executing tool writes. Actions were performed only on the authenticated user’s orders. Tool calls confirm successful cancellations with immediate refunds to the gift card and returns requested with refunds upon completion, and the agent’s statements align with tool outputs. No fabricated or unsupported information, and no policy violations observed.
